title: {name} pricing
description: What {name} costs: nothing for a person, with no account and no card, and one price a year for a large organisation, whatever its size.
h1: Free for you, paid for by organisations.

turn.body: Nothing to buy before you try.
faq.title: Questions
faq.items: Yes. Its code is open source under the MIT licence, so what is free today cannot be taken back.
Can an organisation try before it pays?
Yes: a 30-day trial key, with every enterprise feature.
On a quote, then an invoice, payable by bank transfer within 30 days.
What happens when a key ends?
Every version released before its end date keeps working, forever. Later versions need a new key.
Is there another price for schools, nonprofits or public bodies?
No, the same rule for all: free under {small} people, {price} a year from {small}. For French public buyers, four years stay under the {threshold} threshold for buying without a procedure.
No. {name} counts no one: the size is the one you give when you ask for a key.
